programs.description: When ill luck befalls a family, Kathiresan decides to please the gods by offering their pet rooster as a sacrifice. However, things do not go as expected as the rooster goes missing.
In what may be the longest raid of his career, a righteous income tax officer takes on a corrupt politician who will go to any lengths to evade legal consequences.
A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

Chandran lies to his boss in order to go and watch a football match, but his boss also attends the match and catches him. Later, to save his job, Chandran is forced to lie about having a twin brother.
An unlucky real estate agent experiences a bit of luck when he wins a car in a contest. However, things take a turn after the car is stolen by anonymous assailants.
Upset that his son wants to settle in London, Balaraju has a bitter argument with him. Later, his grandson travels to India to mend the relationship between his father and grandfather.
Two childhood friends lose touch over the years as one grows up to become a national figure while another makes a living out of barbering. Little do they know that a surprise reunion is on the cards.
The son of a brave yet impaired policeman, Murali, dreams of a secure future in banking. However, unforeseen circumstances lead him to follow his father's footsteps in law enforcement.
Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.
Facing a menacing criminal kingpin, Ram fights to protect his family. Soon, he embarks on a daring mission to topple the villain and dismantle his corrupt empire.
Anu and Sanju develop a great bond after the latter arrives in Hyderabad and moves in with Anu and her father. However, they realise their love for each other when Anu is set to marry another man.
Raja and Prem, twins separated at birth but connected through reflexes, join forces as adults to take down an underground smuggling kingpin who threatens to destroy their family.
A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.
A housewife content with her life still sometimes dreams of independence. Later, her wishes come true when an unexpected opportunity to become a radio jockey arises.
Murugan steals groceries from passing trucks in order to make a living. However, things take a turn when he comes across Masani, a corrupt and perverted inspector.
With limited evidence in a race against time, two police officers must combine their skills and experience to arrest a psychopath targeting women.
As Pushpa, a labourer, rises in the world of red sandalwood smuggling, he ends up making many enemies. However, violence ensues when the police try to topple his illegal business.
The exiled prince Raghav embarks on a perilous journey to rescue his wife, Janaki, from the clutches of the demon king Lankesh. He must gather an army to wage an epic battle against evil forces.

Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.
A local thief, who lives in the village of Anjanadri, comes across a Hanuman-like power. He must protect people from the peril that looms over them.
A dedicated police officer struggles to balance his duty to his job and his family obligations when his brother is arrested for murder.
Rajinikanth falls in love with Leela, his sister's friend. They set out on a road trip and meet with an accident, which exposes both their secrets.
A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.
Two rival artists at Sivadas Swamigal's drama troupe compete in everything they do. While one of them goes on to become successful, the other fails in life.
Arivu desires a real love connection but ends up with Leela, who marries him out of family obligation. However, despite their differences, he tries his best to win her over.
Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.
Dayalan, a teacher, tries to change the ongoing malpractices in a government school. Unfortunately, his acts are not welcomed by a few senior members and students, which leads to a rift between them.
The life of struggling news anchor, Engels Ramaswamy, and his family changes when a goddess appears before them. Later, with the help of the goddess, Engels sets out to expose fake godmen.
A businessman saves a policeman from a group of thugs. As a result, he incurs the wrath of a ruthless local gangster who is also an assassin.
A money-minded local goon is hired to protect a woman from her family's rivals. However, he, initially, only accepts the job for the money but later falls in love with her.
Tej, a young man, gets banished from his family for breaking his sister's marriage. He moves to London where he falls in love with a beautiful girl, Nandini.
A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.
A journalist finds himself in the crosshairs of a dreaded counterfeiting racket. Eventually, he decides to use his investigative skills to expose the racket and save his career.
A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.
Following heartbreak from his university sweetheart, Joe embraces the concept of an arranged marriage, seeking a fresh beginning.
Just when the prince of Khansaar is about to rise to the throne, a plan of overthrowing him is exercised and only one man can help him retrieve power.
Sathya is a poor man in search of his sister, who has been kidnapped by human traffickers. However, an illegal brain transplant puts him in the shoes of a billionaire named Vijay.
Subhash, an army man, seeks vengeance when a conspiracy claims his loved ones. He investigates the plot and takes matters into his own hands, mounting a daring operation to capture the culprit.

Five members of a Facebook movie enthusiasts group decide to meet up in an old bungalow to make a short film. However, things go haywire as the gang begins to experience paranormal activities and seek aid from a mentalist.
Inspired by Mahendra Singh Dhoni, a 14-year-old boy dreams of becoming a cricketer. However, his father, a government employee, has other plans.

When identical twins reunite after parting ways during their childhood, they find themselves trapped in a labyrinth of secrets, deception and crime.
A toddy seller's son becomes a politician and overcomes multiple challenges in order to take revenge from the bar owner, who mistreated his father.
After committing a revenge killing, a man serves time in prison, but the repercussions of his crime continue to haunt his family long after.
Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

Tenali Ramakrishna, a lawyer who only cares about money, decides whether to win or lose lawsuits based on how he can gain from them. His life changes when he is given a criminal case, and he chooses to fight for justice.
Arul visits his hometown for a wedding. He meets a relative whose kindness helps him reconnect with forgotten family ties and precious memories.

Bullet Raja is killed by Babu, a goon, because both love the same girl. Bullet fights with the god of death and is sent back into the body of Ravindra, a minister who was killed by his own associates.

Karthik, raised in the slums by his brother, is an engineering student who was abandoned years ago by their father, Jothi. However, his life takes a drastic turn when Jothi exploits Karthik's friend for a drug-peddling assignment.
David, a don, sends Bhai, a hitman, to Hyderabad to kill a policeman who is disrupting mafia operations. However, when Bhai learns that the officer is his own brother, he decides to protect him.

Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.
Ambikathy, an orphan, leaves his cruel uncle and ends up at Marina Beach, where he sells food to save money for night school, determined to pursue his dream of getting an education.
In an attempt to give up his violent past, a man decides to change himself for the woman he loves. Soon, when his lover's family is threatened by evil forces, he takes matters into his own hands.
The life of a poverty-stricken family becomes more complicated after an unanticipated visitor who goes by the name Arjunan, enters their household.
Paranormal activities begin to happen when a crew starts excavating a temple that is believed to be concealed beneath the earth.
A taxi driver, a gangster and an athlete want to create a space for themselves. However, when fate strikes, they end up losing everything and their struggle towards reclaiming their lives begins.
Pullu Giri is trying to live a peaceful life and forget his ruffian past. Following an incident, he gets dragged into the affairs of some local gangs.
Seven young contestants take part in a reality TV show. They spend a week inside a haunted house and soon witness paranormal activities around them.

The incredible, inspiring real-life story of a boy from Chambal who aims to achieve an impossible dream - passing the entrance exam of the world's toughest civil services, the Union Public Service Commission.

Prabha prepares to meet Nandini, his childhood friend, at a reunion party organised by his father. However, things take a turn when Nisha, a gangster's daughter, falls in love with him.
A tech-savvy person is given a task to fix the mobile connection of an entire city, unaware that the completion of it could activate a bomb explosion.
Arun and Divya have been dating for six years. However, their relationship goes through a rough patch when insecurities and possessiveness creep in.
Being the prime witness, a former policewoman who cannot see must unveil a horrific case of serial abduction where the culprit has unleashed a reign of terror in the city of Chennai.
After a heist, Shiva and his crew hide out in an abandoned bungalow. However, they are soon haunted by spooky occurrences.
Karthik, a businessman, gets married to a rich woman, to increase his wealth. However, things change, when he falls in love with an environmental activist, who files a suit against his company.
Living a quiet life with his niece, Eeswaran manages to provide for her and nurtures her like a parent. However, his journey takes an insidious turn when she goes missing.
Dev, a retired astronaut, attempts to repair a faulty satellite in outer space. If he is unable to fix the problem, it can lead to a blackout across the world.
An orphan boy, Nela Ticket, is raised by Ananda Bhupathi at his orphanage in Bangalore. Years later, when Ananda is killed by a corrupt politician, Nela sets out to take revenge.

A bodyguard is assigned to protect Keerthi, the daughter of Naidu. Problems arise when the bodyguard develops feelings for an anonymous lady admirer, unaware that it is Keerthi.
In the year 2028, a power struggle on an international level creates political turmoil in India. Thamizh, a common man, rises to the occasion to save the day.
Aadhi along with a police officer, Maithreyan, embark on a mission to smuggle temple idols in order to make quick money.
A father's excessive concern for his son and interference in his life leads to the latter harbouring bitterness towards his overbearing father.
An idle youngster causes chaos in the life of a disciplined banker, whose struggles with his demanding boss are further complicated by the youth's carefree attitude.
A boy becomes an atheist after his parents' death. Unbeknown to him, he is born for a divine purpose and must stop a demon from sacrificing his lover.
A wealthy entrepreneur returns home to reconcile with a former classmate. Upon discovering his companion's dire predicament, he intervenes and becomes a heroic saviour for the entire community.
